title: TENET5 Social Media OSINT Collection Schema
description: Data structure for tracking social media coordination patterns across Facebook, X (Twitter), and Bluesky in relation to CBC coverage

x_twitter.legal_basis: Publicly posted content, no TOS violation

bluesky.collection_method: AT Protocol public firehose + manual archival
bluesky.legal_basis: Publicly posted content on open protocol

temporal_correlation.description: Measures time delta between CBC article publication and social media activity spikes

metrics.name: cbc_to_social_latency_minutes
metrics.description: Minutes between CBC story publish timestamp and first coordinated social media response

metrics.name: attack_velocity_posts_per_hour
metrics.description: Number of negative posts targeting a specific individual per hour after CBC coverage

metrics.name: cross_platform_spread_minutes
metrics.description: Minutes for narrative to appear on second platform after first

network_analysis.description: Graph-based analysis of account relationships and coordination

metrics.name: coordination_score
metrics.description: 0-100 score measuring how synchronized account behavior is
metrics.calculation: Weighted combination of temporal clustering, content similarity, and target overlap

metrics.name: hub_centrality
metrics.description: Betweenness centrality score identifying key amplifier accounts

metrics.name: cluster_density
metrics.description: Density of connections within identified coordinated groups

linguistic_fingerprinting.description: Identifying shared language patterns suggesting coordinated messaging

metrics.name: phrase_overlap_ratio
metrics.description: Percentage of identical multi-word phrases across accounts

metrics.name: talking_point_velocity
metrics.description: Speed at which new talking points propagate through the network

metrics.name: sentiment_uniformity
metrics.description: Standard deviation of sentiment scores — low deviation suggests coordination

media_social_loop.description: Detecting the feedback loop between CBC coverage and social media harassment
pattern_sequence: 1. CBC publishes story featuring individual X as source/expert
2. Individual X is observed conducting social media attacks on critics of the CBC narrative
3. Accounts connected to X amplify the attacks across platforms
4. CBC never covers the harassment pattern
5. CBC features individual X again in subsequent coverage
evidence_requirements: CBC story URL with publication timestamp
Archived social media posts with timestamps (Wayback Machine / archive.today)
Network graph showing connection between CBC-featured individual and attacking accounts
Temporal correlation showing attacks spiking within 24 hours of CBC coverage
Documentation that CBC has not covered the harassment pattern

influencer_tracking.description: Framework for identifying primary players in the coordination network

tiers.label: PRIMARY_AMPLIFIERS
tiers.criteria: Accounts that appear in CBC stories AND conduct social media coordination
tiers.minimum_evidence: 3 documented CBC appearances + 5 documented coordinated social media actions

tiers.label: SECONDARY_AMPLIFIERS
tiers.criteria: Accounts that amplify Tier 1 content and participate in pile-ons
tiers.minimum_evidence: 10 documented amplification events + temporal correlation with Tier 1

tiers.label: NETWORK_NODES
tiers.criteria: Accounts that connect Tier 1 and Tier 2 through cross-platform sharing

evidence_threshold.naming_public: Tier 1 only, with 5+ documented instances, publicly available evidence
evidence_threshold.analysis_internal: All tiers tracked internally for pattern analysis

commissioner_of_lobbying.description: Cross-reference social media actors with registered lobbying activity

cbc_byline_database.description: Track which CBC journalists quote which sources — map to social media presence

hansard_cross_reference.description: Check if social media talking points mirror Hansard committee testimony

crtc_filings.description: Public broadcasting regulatory filings showing CBC content obligations

reporting_schedule.format: Data visualization + narrative analysis + source citations
reporting_schedule.review: Legal review before any individual is named
